title: High: a guard stops a session from printing process arguments, which can hold secrets
why: Degen gap 7. Owner 20:25 CST Nov 9: queue each of Degen's eight claude-settings gaps as a step or debt, with its incident (via the coordinator 20:30 CST). Incident: the Degen coordinator printed the Tailscale auth key with a process listing (`ps`, `pgrep -a`), 2026-11-09 19:59 CST. A leaked secret cannot be undone.
note: Priority high (coordinator). Fix: refuse or mask `ps` and `pgrep` forms that print full argv (ps -ef/aux/-o args, pgrep -a/-l -f, /proc/*/cmdline reads), with a narrow pid-and-name form allowed. Related: precommit-secrets-symlinks. Filed 20:27 CST Nov 9.
